name: Power Simulator 2
seoDescription: Power Simulator 2 codes give tokens, coins, and aura rerolls to unlock powers and upgrade faster. Find working codes and redeem them easily in-game.
introMd: Power Simulator 2 lets you train powers and face off against villains like Dark Surge. Codes in this game give you tokens, coins, and aura rerolls that help you unlock new abilities faster. Using Power Simulator 2 codes can save you time and boost your progress by adding extra resources directly to your account.
redeemMd:
## How to Redeem Power Simulator 2 Codes
You don’t need to meet any special requirements to redeem codes in Power Simulator 2. Just follow these simple steps.
1. [[roblox_link|Launch Power Simulator 2]].
2. Watch the intro cutscene if it appears.
3. Look for the Twitter Bird button at the top of the screen and click it.
4. Enter a working code exactly as shown into the text box.
5. Press Enter on your keyboard to claim your rewards.
6. Repeat for each code you want to redeem.
rewardsMd:
## What Rewards You Normally Get?
Codes in Power Simulator 2 mostly give you tokens, coins, and aura rerolls. Here’s what each reward does:

| Reward Type  | Description                                         |
|--------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| Tokens       | The main currency used to buy powers and upgrades. |
| Coins        | Another currency that can be spent on various items.|
| Aura Rerolls | Allows you to reroll your aura to get better stats. |

These rewards help you train faster and improve your character’s abilities in the Powerverse.
troubleshootMd:
## Why Codes Might Not Work
Codes might fail if you don’t enter them exactly as shown, including capitalization. Also, expired codes won’t work anymore. Make sure you are entering the codes in the right place by clicking the Twitter Bird button at the top of the screen.
findCodesMd:
## Where to Find New Power Simulator 2 Codes
The developer often drops new codes on their official Discord server, especially in the #announcements channel. Codes also appear on their social media pages listed below the game. New codes usually release around milestones like reaching a certain number of likes or special events.
